Check that the geometry of a GeoScale is on the right regions

Source: R/check-geometry.R
check_geometry_geoscale.Rd

The geometry of a GeoScale is one shape per leaf, in the row order of the leaftable, with no codes of its own. A shape bound to the wrong row gives a map in which the regions carry each other's values, and nothing fails. check_geometry_geoscale() looks for that.

Usage

check_geometry_geoscale(
  x,
  reference = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  geoframe = NULL,
  tolerance = 0.999,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A GeoScale with geometry attached.

reference

Optional sf object with one or more features per code: the source the geometry came from, or any trusted map of the same regions.

by

Name of the code column of reference. Defaults to a column named as geoframe.

geoframe

The geoframe reference describes. Defaults to the leaf geoframe; a coarser one compares the dissolved shapes.

tolerance

Share of area two shapes must have in common to count as the same shape, between 0 and 1. Default 0.999.

quiet

FALSE (default) warns when a check fails.

Value

A data.frame of class geoscale_geometry_check with columns check, geoframe, region, status ("ok", "note", "warn" or "fail") and detail, one row per finding. all(out$status != "fail") says whether it passed.

Details

With a reference – an sf object that carries the codes – the check is a proof: every shape of the object is compared with the reference shape of the same code, and a misplaced shape is reported with the code it really belongs to.

Without one the object is searched for the marks a misplacement leaves, which is evidence, not proof:

  • shapes: empty shapes, and one shape held by several leaves;

  • area: a weight that holds the areas of the shapes in another row order, as happens when the shapes moved after add_area_geoscale() measured them;

  • pieces: a grouped region whose leaves do not form one connected piece. Islands do this legitimately, so it is a warning;

  • order: whether the constructor re-sorted the rows, after which a geometry attached by position cannot be checked.

See also

attach_geometry_geoscale(), geoscale_geometry()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gs <- attach_geometry_geoscale(gs, shapes, by = "code")
check_geometry_geoscale(gs)                         # internal evidence
check_geometry_geoscale(gs, reference = shapes, by = "code")   # proof
} # }
